generator.rasterization: Chrome software rasterization (--disable-gpu), sRGB; settle two frames before/after mounting each element
generator.png: lossless RGBA PNG; zero RGB at alpha=0; no palette quantization

conventions.pixelSize: physical file pixels; null for fonts/raw vectors/licenses
conventions.anchor: pixel location of reference origin (0,0); subtract when placing a bitmap
conventions.logicalBounds: reference units, including overflow; atlas frame anchors describe the frame rather than full texture

holographic.appliesTo: art bitmap only; animated eyes remain unaffected

eyes.ring: 3 CSS px (default --ew); keep fixed per logical pixel rather than scaling with radius
eyes.scaleRule: choose nearest native radius and scale pupil freely; eye whites at other radii should be a circle with the documented fixed ring/inset shade

photo.coverage: Calibrated from black/white photos through the unchanged full filter. M=A/(1-O); O=(T-A-(1-A)*S)/(1-S), where T is total filter alpha and S is shadow alpha. Geometric-mask stores unadjusted rounded-rect coverage. Use mask with overlay on top.
